motion_timing.evidence: 正常时间播放，不用慢镜头。

creative_direction.evidence: 家庭日常与克制观看，参考李安对关系压力与克制反应的处理。借助视线、人物距离和小动作表达靠近，不用夸张哭喊。只用现场声音，不加配乐；镜头之间采用硬切。
creative_direction.rationale: 用户明确要求以情绪与关系为主、不增加冲突或反转，并指定李安式克制反应；因此用视线、距离和递水等小动作承载靠近，不使用夸张表演、密集肢体交互或配乐。
creative_direction.guidance: Creative direction v1: Express emotional changes through small shifts in gaze, distance, posture and handling of established objects; leave room for a reaction without forcing exaggerated gestures. Use depth, thresholds and relative placement to reveal the established relationships within a group; keep the current dramatic focus readable without giving every person an isolated close-up. Compose shot boundaries for direct cuts; do not bake fades or dissolves into the footage. Use only scene-native sound, with no musical score or added background music. Apply relevant methods to this authored shot, not every method to every beat. Explicit subject tempo, playback treatment, camera blocking, exact choreography, reference motion, ordered outcomes and allocated duration take precedence. Do not add story events, change the ending or infer slow motion from a cinematic reference.

locations.description: 普通城市住宅内的家用餐厅空间，连通入户玄关与厨房，临窗位置可看到雨夜的室外街景，摆放原木方形餐桌与配套木质餐椅，墙面为米白色，顶部安装暖黄色吸顶灯，整体陈设简单日常，无多余装饰，全片所有动作均发生在该空间内。
